thread:
sam wu: Proposal: expose a tiny "fallback" header and a soft console badge so customers know when we route to an alternate model for cost/capacity/quality. Keep it non-scary and rate-limited.

elaine r.: 👍 headers good. what's the exact format? we need a stable enum for reasons.

sam wu: Minimal example: `X-RW-FB: r=budget;id=9b3c1f;path=gpt4-q|gpt3s;e=0;cs=1` and optional `X-RW-BUD: route=chat.generate;burn=81;window=5m`. Reasons: budget|capacity|quality|policy.

diego m.: Telemetry: add `fallback.count`, `fallback.cost_delta_usd_sum`, `route.budget_pct`, and p95 latency deltas. Also tag experiment fallbacks so rollouts aren't counted.

elsine r.: UX: badge text "Budget high" (hover: "Some requests routed to alternate model to preserve availability"). Only show badge when fallback rate >5% in 5m or burn >80%. Banner auto-open threshold >20% for >10m.

ops-bot: Note: sampled trace ids included; redact prompt/content per data policy. TTL for quick trace index = 7d.

sam wu: Plan: 1) routing emits headers (P0) 2) telemetry schema update (P1) 3) SDK pill + link (P1) 4) console badge + diagnostics table (P1). I'll file RFC with examples and privacy notes today.

elaine r.: assign SDK work to next sprint.

diego m.: I'll sketch metric schema PR.

ops-bot: RFC created: RW-5012 "Fallback signals: headers + console badge" (link: https://go/repo/RW-5012).
